name: app-6a7319344d54819188816dfb8b382506
description: Generate invoice PDFs and batch ZIP downloads from user-supplied details.

interface.longDescription: InvoicePig generates one or multiple invoice PDFs from user-supplied invoice details and returns short-lived PDF and ZIP download links. It does not fetch source documents, perform OCR, save invoice history, or manage logos through MCP.
capabilities: Generate batch PDF and ZIP downloads
defaultPrompt: Create an invoice PDF from my invoice details.
Generate a ZIP containing several invoice PDFs.
Create an invoice PDF without a logo.

positive.description: Generate one invoice from complete user-supplied fields.
positive.prompt: Generate one invoice PDF using exactly these details: issuer Northstar Design; bill to Acme Studio, 12 Market Street, Portland, OR; invoice number INV-1001; invoice date 2026-08-03; due date 2026-08-17; currency USD; payment terms Net 14; no tax, discount, shipping, or amount paid; line item id consulting-1, description Design consulting, details 10 hours, quantity 10, rate 120.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one generated invoice PDF with a short-lived downloadable link.

positive.description: Generate one invoice with tax from complete user-supplied fields.
positive.prompt: Generate one classic invoice PDF using exactly these details: issuer Oak & Co; bill to Arbor Labs, 8 Rue des Fleurs, Paris; invoice number OAK-204; invoice date 2026-08-03; due date 2026-09-02; currency EUR; payment terms Net 30; show tax at 20%; no discount, shipping, or amount paid; line item id research-1, description Research services, details August engagement, quantity 1, rate 850.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one invoice PDF link and does not claim to have fetched or OCR'd a source document.

positive.description: Generate several independent invoices as a batch.
positive.prompt: Generate a batch of two invoice PDFs in this order. Invoice 1: issuer Northstar Design; bill to Acme Studio, Portland, OR; invoice number INV-2001; invoice date 2026-08-03; due date 2026-08-17; currency USD; no tax, discount, shipping, or amount paid; line item id design-1, description Design retainer, details August, quantity 1, rate 1500. Invoice 2: issuer Northstar Design; bill to Beacon Works, Seattle, WA; invoice number INV-2002; invoice date 2026-08-03; due date 2026-08-17; currency USD; no tax, discount, shipping, or amount paid; line item id support-1, description Support hours, details 5 hours, quantity 5, rate 95.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ZIP download plus individual artifact links, with results in input order.

positive.description: Generate the maximum supported batch size.
positive.prompt: Generate a batch of exactly 10 invoice PDFs. For each invoice use issuer Vertex Services; bill to Demo Customer; invoice date 2026-08-03; due date 2026-08-17; currency USD; no tax, discount, shipping, or amount paid; and one line item with id service, description Monthly service, details Demo plan, quantity 1, rate 100. Set the invoice numbers in this exact order: BATCH-01, BATCH-02, BATCH-03, BATCH-04, BATCH-05, BATCH-06, BATCH-07, BATCH-08, BATCH-09, BATCH-10.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ZIP download plus ten individual PDF artifact links in the supplied invoice order.

positive.description: Generate an invoice without a logo.
positive.prompt: Generate a minimal USD invoice PDF from Northstar Design to Acme Studio, invoice INV-NO-LOGO, dated 2026-10-15 and due 2026-10-29. Include one Design consulting line, quantity 2, rate 100. No logo, tax, discount, shipping, or amount paid.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a PDF download link for the requested invoice with no logo.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside invoice generation.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a calculation-only request.
negative.prompt: What is 10 hours at $120 per hour? Do not create an invoice PDF.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the user requested only a calculation, not a PDF artifact.

negative.description: Do not trigger for invoice-history retrieval.
negative.prompt: Find all of my invoices from last year and download them.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because InvoicePig does not save or retrieve invoice history.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools generate private invoice PDF and ZIP artifacts. They do not sell goods, initiate payments, send invoices to customers, or move funds. InvoicePig offers paid subscription plans on its website.

publication.release_notes: Remove MCP logo management and its widget and upload flow. Retain single and batch PDF generation with private download links. Add the reviewer demo recording and clarify commerce behavior. MCP server version 3.0.0.
